chunk_text: [Intelligence That Adapts To Every Sector, Every Use Case] Global Price & Cost Analysis Businesses often make pricing and sourcing decisions without knowing the actual market rates buyers are paying worldwide. Different regions have different price points, and without trade-level visibility, companies risk underpricing, overpricing, or losing margins to uninformed decisions. Market Inside brings shipment-level pricing to the surface, giving you clear visibility into unit prices, total invoice values, currency conversions, quantity, and buyer - seller pricing patterns. Every shipment includes accurate INR and USD values, unit prices, and global pricing comparisons - helping teams benchmark smarter. Benefits Compare HS-code prices across countries and identify profitable buyer markets. Use multi-currency price visibility to assess cost competitiveness and benchmark pricing globally Track historical price trends to spot underpriced or overpriced segments early. Strengthen negotiations with invoice-backed, evidence-based pricing insights. Didn't Find Your Answer Here! Chat with us Call Us WhatsApp Us 01 What is the Market Inside Trade Data API? Our Trade Data API is a set of programmatic tools that let businesses access import-export data directly within their own software. It helps them track global trade activities like shipment histories, trade flows, company intelligence, HS-code data, and supply chain relationships without relying on manual searches or external dashboards. 02 Which data sources are used for the API? The API is built on Customs Data, Bill of Lading records, shipping manifests, and global company registries. Each dataset is standardized across countries to ensure consistent structure, accuracy, and compatibility with your internal tools. 03 How do I get access and what data can I query? You can request a demo or trial to receive your API key and full documentation. Once activated, you can query shipment-level records, company profiles, HS-code classifications, product descriptions, port data, and supplier - buyer connections using flexible filters and parameters. 04 How is the data updated? Datasets refresh continuously as new customs and company records are published. Update frequency depends on each region, but the API always surfaces the latest licensed data. 05 Is the API REST-based? Yes! It is a standard REST API with structured JSON responses, clear endpoints, and standard filters. It is designed for developers to integrate into any stack (Python, Java, Node, etc.) easily. 06 Are there usage limits? Each subscription includes request and data-volume limits based on your plan. If you need more, you can upgrade or talk to us for a custom allowance. 07 Can I filter the data by country, HS code, company, or port? Absolutely. The API supports granular filtering by HS Code, origin/destination country, importer/exporter name, port, and date range. 08 Is the data compliant and legal to use? Yes. All information is collected under proper licenses and regional regulations. Your subscription gives you the rights to use it according to your agreement. Turning Complex Global Trade Data into Reliable, Actionable Intelligence. Market Inside Data empowers businesses with accurate, fast, and insight-driven trade intelligence — giving companies the clarity and confidence needed to make high-impact decisions.In a space where most platforms still offer incomplete data, outdated interfaces, and slow updates, we focus on what truly matters:clean data, real insights, and an experience built around solving real business challenges. Request a Demo Start for Free Our Story Building the Future, Together. Founded in 2019, Market Inside Data was built on a strong observation: Most trade-data solutions were designed around raw data, not the real problems businesses were struggling with. Organizations were drowning in: inconsistent information inconsistent information delayed updates heavy manual research unclear insights cluttered and outdated tools We saw the need for a platform that worked differently — one that didn’t just provide data, but delivered end-to-end clarity, speed, and ease of use.
